## What you want

A clear description of the feature or endpoint you would like to see.

## Xero reference

If this maps to a Xero endpoint, link the official documentation or name the
path and method. The SDK tracks the Xero OpenAPI specs as its source of truth,
so a spec reference helps a lot.

## Use case

What are you trying to build? This helps shape the API.
